title: Mastery Threshold Chooser
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Examine a table of pass probabilities for five mastery rules and select every rule that meets each of four requirements.

learningObjectives: The learner will examine a table of pass probabilities for five mastery rules and select the rule or rules that meet each of four stated requirements, correctly answering at least three of four.
prerequisites: Mastery threshold, false pass, false fail, and pass probability, from the section "The Mastery Threshold" in Chapter 12

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, get feedback with the reason, and review what was missed
keyQuestions: How often does each rule pass a student who has not mastered the skill?
How often does it hold back one who has?
commonMisconceptions: A stricter rule is always better
"Four of five" is a high standard
A rule that never passes a weak student also passes every strong one
assessmentOpportunities: Which rule passes a 70 percent student about half the time?
Is a stricter rule always better?
Which rule meets: 70% student under 50% and 90% student at least 90%?

controls.name: Five rule buttons
controls.description: mark or unmark a rule. Marked rules are shaded in the table.

controls.name: Check
controls.description: commits the marked set. Two checks per requirement; only the first counts.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: moves to the next requirement after feedback. On the results screen, Previous missed and Next missed step through what you missed.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: starts a practice run. Practice runs do not change the first-run score.
